factual_claims.claim: The prevalence of cloud-based inference and managed vector database services in current RAG architectures creates significant barriers for deployment in privacy-sensitive or air-gapped environments.

Industries like finance, healthcare, government, and legal services are restricted by data protection requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, and ISO/IEC 27001 from transferring confidential documents outside organizational boundaries.
RAGStack operates on a standard CPU-only machine (8-core Intel i7, 16GB RAM) with response times of a few seconds on a corpus of 1,000+ chunks.
RAGStack provides source traceability in over 90% of cases during internal testing.
